steps.summary: Signed in to Repair Desk as bench@example.com, opened "New ticket", created a ticket titled exactly 'fwrd68-n3 RD Bench Ticket RD Bench Ticket' with customer 'Bench Customer' (the only other field on the form; Title was the only required one). After submit the dialog closed and the list refreshed, showing the new row at the top: RD-1017, 'fwrd68-n3 RD Bench Ticket RD Bench Ticket', 'Bench Customer', status 'Draft', 0 parts, created 2026-09-17. No explicit toast/confirmation text was rendered — the confirmation was the new row appearing in the Tickets list (and the row's Ref opens a detail view).

On ticket RD-1017's detail page I added, via the "Add part" dialog, part A named exactly 'fwrd68-n3 RD Bench Ticket RD Part A' (cost 100, markup 25) and part B named exactly 'fwrd68-n3 RD Bench Ticket RD Part B' (cost 200, markup 25); the dialog closed and the parts table refreshed after each add, showing both rows. The app computed and displayed $125.00 for Part A and $250.00 for Part B (cost + 25% markup), i.e. 100×1.25 and 200×1.25, with a ticket total of $375.00 under the row "Total (price × quantity)". Ticket is still status Draft, customer Bench Customer, raised 2026-09-17. No toast/confirmation text beyond the table's note "Price is calculated from cost and markup when the part is saved."

On ticket RD-1017's detail page the ticket was already in status 'Draft', and a Draft ticket has no 'Mark Draft' button: the app's only status button from Draft is 'Mark Ready' (Draft→Ready, Ready→Draft/Closed; 'Mark Draft' appears only once the ticket is Ready). Clicking it was refused with the alert 'Ticket is not ready Part "fwrd68-n3 RD Part A" has no supplier Part "fwrd68-n3 RD Part B" has no supplier', so the precondition is that every part carries a supplier. I satisfied it through the ticket's Edit part form on each part, setting Supplier = 'Bench Supplier' (the parts table then refreshed and showed 'Bench Supplier' in both rows instead of 'No supplier'). Retrying the status change then succeeded — the ticket showed Ready with 'Mark Draft'/'Mark Closed' buttons — and clicking 'Mark Draft' returned the ticket to Draft. A full page reload confirmed the persisted final state: status badge 'Draft', buttons 'Mark Ready' + 'Archive ticket', parts fwrd68-n3 RD Part A ($150.00, 25%, qty 1, Bench Supplier, price $187.50) and fwrd68-n3 RD Part B ($200.00, 25%, qty 1, Bench Supplier, price $250.00), total $437.50. No further validation/error message was shown for the Draft transition itself, and the error and status regions were empty once it succeeded.
